purpose: Classify new rekordbox tracks by the user's set dramaturgy and local library taste, not just Beatport genre.

colors.Orange: Indie / acid / club breaks / Future House crossover
colors.Yellow: House / piano / classic club language; not generic Future House

taste_profile: Local database taste is the primary authority. Web genres and Beatport metadata are supporting evidence only.
Do not map rare colors broadly. Orange is now accepted for a subset of Indie Dance, but it usually remains rating 3 / JOURNEY rather than automatic MAIN.

Progressive House is intentionally broad in this library. Do not treat its spread across Purple, Blue, Green, Orange, or Red-adjacent roles as a contradiction; decide from track function, mood, and neighboring library examples.
Melodic House & Techno is not automatically peak. Ben Böhmer-style melodic remixes and deep melodic material can be WARM/JOURNEY with Aqua/Blue/Purple rather than Red.
Breaks around 122 BPM often belongs to Aqua, rating 2, warm/open/journey. Do not make low-BPM breaks Orange MAIN by default.
Organic House can become Organic / Downtempo, Electronica, or Progressive depending on the track. Do not force all organic material to OPEN rating 1.
House and Tech House should stay House/Tech House unless there is strong evidence for a more specific club lane. Do not fall back to Dance / Pop just because iTunes says Pop.

Indie Dance is no longer mostly Green by default. Instrumental atmospheric Indie Dance may be Orange/JOURNEY; dark/acid/bass/techno-leaning Indie Dance may be Red; broken/acid/breaks-leaning Indie Dance may be Aqua/Blue.
Drum & Bass is not automatic Red/PEAK in this library. Vocal/emotional DnB can be Pink/MAIN TIME, deep/atmospheric DnB can be Aqua/WARM or JOURNEY, and dark/driving DnB may be Purple/MAIN TIME.
Fast Breaks around 130-132 BPM can be Orange when acid/driving/hypnotic, but vocal/atmospheric Breaks may be Blue/JOURNEY and deep Breaks may be Aqua/WARM.
Progressive House uses Purple for dark/driving/hypnotic journey or peak material; Blue is mostly deep/warm, Green can appear for hypnotic/organic-leaning journey tracks.

Color and Rating are independent signals. Blue can carry rating 3-4 MAIN TIME when the track is emotional, vocal, melodic, or trance-leaning; do not force it toward Orange or Red only because energy rises.
Purple can carry rating 4 and MAIN TIME/PEAK for dark, hypnotic, acid, or psychedelic Progressive House while remaining a progressive journey rather than Red peak-time techno.

Orange describes a clubby, acid, indie, psychedelic, or broken-beat character and is not an automatic high Rating. Orange tracks can remain rating 2-3 and WARM/JOURNEY when that is their dramatic function.
Green is a restrained organic/deep lane, not a synonym for low quality or OPEN. It can hold rating 2-3 WARM/JOURNEY when the track develops the set without becoming dark or club-forward.

Rating, Set Role, and Color are three independent decisions. Rating is intensity, Set Role is dramatic placement, and Color is sonic lane. Unusual combinations are allowed when current manual examples support them.

Fresh 2026-08-22 corrections confirm that Red/MAIN or Red/PEAK can deliberately carry rating 2 for dark bass-heavy Melodic Techno or Indie Dance. Treat this as a review-sensitive pattern, not an automatic cleanup error.
Blue can carry the full intensity range. Emotional or vocal Trance can be Blue at rating 3-5 and MAIN TIME; energy must not force it into Red.
Aqua can carry PEAK when high-BPM Breaks remain emotional, melodic, or leftfield. BPM and role must not force emotional Breaks into Orange.
Yellow is now a stable House lane across WARM, JOURNEY, and MAIN TIME at ratings 2-4, especially for piano, vocal, deep, or classic club language.
Purple can describe warm Breaks, hypnotic Progressive, journey Psy-Trance, or emotional Trance MAIN TIME. It is a sonic family rather than a fixed energy level.
Melodic Techno splits by function: Drumcode/Massano/dark/driving material can be Red/PEAK, while Marsh/PIAS/vocal/deep melodic material can be Blue or Aqua and rating 2-3.
House and Deep House can be Yellow when they read as classic, piano, vocal, or main-time club material.
Techno peak-time material with Acid/Dark/Driving/Hypnotic tags often sits Red/MAIN TIME at rating 3-4; not every such track needs rating 5.
Psy-Trance should generally not become Red in this library. Use Purple for classic/journey psy and Orange for acid/dark/driving main-time psy; Red is not the meaning of this lane.
Organic/Afro material can become Orange when it is hypnotic, driving, or main-time leaning, but it should not become PEAK by default.

A source or embedded genre is only evidence. If the rhythm is clearly broken, keep Breaks as a normalized MyTag and allow the metadata genre to be corrected separately after listening; do not force a 4x4 lane from the release label alone.

Emotional Progressive/Trance crossovers can carry both Progressive House and Trance MyTags while staying Blue at MAIN TIME. Multiple genre tags are useful when they describe real neighboring lanes rather than uncertainty.
Low-pressure broken-beat versions can be Aqua and rating 1 even when the artist or label usually maps to Purple progressive. Track-level rhythm and intensity override artist priors.
Indie/Melodic Techno crossovers can be Orange while retaining both Indie Dance and Melodic Techno MyTags. Red is reserved for darker pressure; melodic-techno metadata alone is insufficient.
Do not infer Instrumental from a dub/remix suffix or missing web credits. Female Vocal and Vocal must be decided from the audio or reliable release evidence.

Do not auto-clean low Rating with MAIN/PEAK. The 2026-08-22 batch confirms some such combinations. Flag only when the sonic lane and neighboring examples do not support the role; WARM UP with Red remains suspicious unless manually confirmed.
Downtempo and beatless/chillout mixes should be OPEN / INTRO even when BPM metadata is misleading.
Classic vocal club remixes may be Yellow or Red and tagged as Techno/House/Classic depending on energy; treat them as special cases for review.
Priority A/B/C is not stable yet. Do not require priority tags during learning batches.

Atmospheric Progressive House must not default to Blue. When established artist neighbors such as Supacooks, M.O.S., Khen, Juan Deminicis, or Nicolas Rada sit in the classic progressive journey lane, prefer Purple unless the specific track has clear deep, vocal, or emotional evidence for Blue.
Low-energy Electronica and ambient-adjacent material belongs to Aqua/OPEN more often than Blue when its main function is leftfield set opening rather than deep melodic warm-up.

Breaks intensity must be judged track by track. A 123 BPM vocal breakbeat track can be Aqua, rating 3, JOURNEY; broken rhythm does not imply rating 1-2. Credited vocalists are strong evidence for Vocal and, when verified, Female Vocal.

manual_examples.track: Julian Nates - Echoes of Another Life
manual_examples.lesson: Acid/dark/hypnotic Progressive House can stay Purple at rating 4 with MAIN TIME/PEAK roles; Purple is allowed to carry the progressive peak without becoming Red.
Psychedelic/acid Organic-Progressive material can be Orange, rating 2, JOURNEY. Orange describes character here, not peak energy.
Indie-leaning melodic material can be Orange, rating 3, while remaining WARM/JOURNEY instead of automatic MAIN TIME.
Emotional female-vocal Breaks can be Blue, rating 4, MAIN TIME; high energy alone does not make broken-beat material Orange or Red.
Emotional female-vocal Trance can be Blue at rating 5 and MAIN TIME. Maximum intensity does not override the emotional color lane.
Dark bass-heavy Melodic Techno can be Red, rating 2, PEAK. Rating and dramatic role are intentionally independent in the current manual model.
Dark/hypnotic Indie-Melodic Techno can be Red, rating 2, PEAK; do not auto-clean the combination only because Rating is low.
High-BPM emotional female-vocal Breaks/Electronica can be Aqua, rating 3, PEAK rather than automatic Orange.
Dark/deep/hypnotic Afro-Organic Indie Dance can be Orange, rating 2, WARM UP. Orange is a crossover character, not a MAIN-only color.
Emotional female-vocal House can be Yellow, rating 4, MAIN TIME; Yellow remains the House lane at high intensity.

set_construction_profile: Prioritize narrative and mood over a perfectly continuous Camelot path. Harmonic compatibility is important, but it may be broken deliberately at a dramatic reset.
Place an emotional or lyrical anchor near the opening instead of delaying all vocal material until MAIN TIME; Marsh - Home was manually inserted at position 2 in playlist 101.
A low-intensity organic track can work as a mid-set breath after a darker progression; it does not have to remain in the opening block.
Build MAIN TIME through emotional Progressive/Trance as well as dark pressure. The user added Durante - Lunar Circuit and Victor Garde - Feel Your Touch to strengthen this transition.
The closing section can alternate Blue emotional and Purple hypnotic material, then release into a lower-rating emotional track. Maximum intensity is not required at the end.
